interpretation: the extinction correction appears to be under-correcting by 9.3% of A_G
caveat: this is an UPPER BOUND on the extinction error. A_0 correlates with distance and galactic latitude, which correlate with stellar population (age, alpha-enhancement, thin vs thick disc), so some of the fitted slope is astrophysical rather than an extinction-correction failure. The two are not separable with this diagnostic alone -- but the colour-split-at-low-extinction test shows a large population term does exist.
